Name: A bigger standard map
Author: lillvik
Description:
[i]Stardew beta 1.3[/i]
The standard farm map height is doubled and the two lakes are removed.

[b]Installation[/b]:
Replace the farm.xnb inside \Stardew Valley\Content\Maps folder.
Replace the forest.xnb inside \Stardew Valley\Content\Maps folder.
[b]
I recommend to backup the original farm map.
I recommend to backup the original forest map.[/b]
